checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable audio file is delivered, not multiple separate music segments.
must.why: A single WAV file was delivered.

must.item: The decoded audio duration is 15.00 seconds, within 0.05 second.
must.why: The file is reported as 15 s. Exact decimals are not given, but 15 s matches the target.

must.item: Music fills the duration rather than padding a shorter track with a long silence.
must.why: The file has sound and peak -1 dB, but there is no data on silence distribution.

must.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must.why: The audio was not heard or transcribed. The prompt style was instrumental.

must.item: Any internal joins are musically smooth, without clicks, gaps or jarring changes in tempo or sound.
must.why: Cannot hear the audio. It is unknown whether there are joins.

faults.what: The assistant said it could not verify the exact length, which weakens confidence. The file reports 15 s, so this is only a minor communication issue.

summary: A single 15 s WAV with sound and a healthy peak level was delivered as an instrumental bed, though vocal absence and smoothness could not be verified.
